description: This file is a shell script used for rewriting Git revision history. It provides functions and procedures to filter, modify, and update commits, tags, and references within a Git repository as part of a custom history rewrite process.

methods.name: warn
methods.description: Outputs a warning message to standard error.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Maps commit identifiers using a stored mapping or returns the original if not mapped.

methods.name: skip_commit
methods.description: Skips a commit by printing its mapped parents, effectively excluding it from history.

methods.name: git_commit_non_empty_tree
methods.description: Creates a commit only if the tree is non-empty, avoiding commits that do not change the tree.

methods.name: die
methods.description: Outputs an error message and terminates the script.

methods.name: finish_ident
methods.description: Sets and exports Git identity variables for author and committer.

methods.name: set_ident
methods.description: Parses author and committer info from a commit and finishes setting the identity variables.
